# PLAN — iteration 3
## Current state assessment
Iteration 1 recovered timing and is the verified incumbent; iteration 2 was rejected because its register-to-register WNS matched the incumbent at 0.148 ns. Iteration 3 must strictly improve that metric while preserving the one-cycle behavior and passing every verification and routed-report gate.

## Hypothesis
For the default symmetric coefficients, conditionally pairing mirrored samples before multiplication should reduce the multiplier count from eight to four and may improve register-to-register setup slack; a general path must preserve behavior when coefficient pairs differ.

## Instruction for generator
Keep `// @latency 1` and preserve the synchronous reset and output cycle behavior. Replace the `x_d` and `s0`–`s6` transposed recurrence with a registered sample delay line and a balanced output sum; in a generate branch where `C0==C7`, `C1==C6`, `C2==C5`, and `C3==C4`, pre-add each mirrored sample pair at 17-bit signed width and multiply by its shared coefficient, preserving the low 32 result bits. Retain a general-coefficient branch for all other parameter values, and compare routed register-to-register WNS against the 0.148 ns incumbent.
